facts.summary: Phase 3 met primary endpoint only in ESR1-mutant subgroup, missed in overall population · Phase 3 · vepdegestrant in ER+/HER2- breast cancer · not yet approved
facts.indication: ER+/HER2- advanced or metastatic breast cancer

evidence.summary: The trial did not reach statistical significance in improvement in PFS in the intent-to-treat (ITT) population.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The trial did not reach statistical significance in improvement in PFS in the intent-to-treat (ITT) population.
evidence.safety: In the trial, vepdegestrant was generally well tolerated and its safety profile was consistent with what has been observed in previous studies.
